description: Implementation of the Ranmihitenna National Tele Cinema Park productively through a private sector investment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑07‑22 to select a suitable investor to implement the Ranmihitenna National Tele Cinema Park under the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Maintenance (DBFOM) model. Further, the Officials' Committee appointed by the Cabinet under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to conduct a review on the State-Owned Non-Commercial Entities has also recommended for calling Expressions of Interest from local and foreign investors to implement the said Cinema Park under a suitable commercial model to increase its utility and revenue. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to implement the Ranmihitenna National Tele Cinema Park through a private investment under the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Maintain (DBFOM) model for a period of 30 years, and to call for expressions of interest from interested investors following a competitive and transparent procurement process, was approved by the Cabinet.
